value.name: Deny vulnerability probes and scrapers
value.description: Bot policy 2026-11-03: deny requests for other software's paths (.env, .git, wp-*, xmlrpc, phpMyAdmin, .aws, .DS_Store, *.php; nothing here serves them) and the SEO-tool and commercial scrapers of webapp/lib/crawlers.ts SCRAPERS (T4, any case), which robots.txt asks to read nothing. Firewall-denied requests cost no function, CDN request or data transfer.
